name: useAnimations
tagline: Micro-animated icons in Lottie and SVG
description: Free animated icons built on a 32px grid and based on the Feather set, exported as both SVG and editable Lottie JSON. Each one ships with a hover or click trigger baked in, which is the detail most icon sets leave for you to build yourself.

best.title: useAnimations
best.note: Every icon grouped by use: alerts, navigation, media, social.

best.title: react-useanimations
best.note: React wrapper package for dropping icons straight into components.
